recognition: CIS late return penalty for a contractor's monthly return (CIS300).

facts_for_explanation.what_it_is: A penalty because a contractor's monthly CIS return reached HMRC after the 19th of the month after the tax month ended.

amounts.6 months late: £300 or 5% of the CIS deductions on the return, whichever is higher
amounts.12 months late: £300 or 5% of the CIS deductions, whichever is higher
amounts.more than 12 months: an additional penalty of up to £3,000 or 100% of the CIS deductions

facts_for_explanation.how_to_appeal: Within 30 days of the penalty notice: online through HMRC's service, or in writing quoting the UTR and the payment reference on the notice. Not by phone.
facts_for_explanation.nil_returns: A return is needed every month unless HMRC has been told the business made no payments to subcontractors (an 'inactivity' notice).

appeal_output.post_to: the address on the penalty notice
appeal_output.online_alternative: HMRC's online appeal service for CIS penalties
